title: Allergy-friendly Taco Soup
description: Ground chicken, black and kidney beans, corn and tomatoes simmer in a homemade taco-spiced broth for a thick, slightly sweet bowl that comes together in one pot.
watch: Check labels on canned goods and chili powder; skip Fritos/cornbread unless you've checked them

title: Gluten & Dairy Free Chicken Salad Sandwich (Egg-Free Option)
description: Shredded chicken tossed with crunchy celery, red onion, sweet grapes and salty sunflower seeds in a tangy Dijon dressing, piled onto GF bread or lettuce leaves.
swaps: Use the egg-free vegan mayo (not regular mayo); use GF vegan bread/buns or lettuce wraps
watch: Check vegan mayo is egg- and nut-free; check seasoned salt and GF bread labels

title: Allergy-friendly Thai Chopped Salad
description: Crisp greens, mandarin oranges, sweet peas, red pepper and shredded chicken get a gingery honey-rice-vinegar dressing, with sunflower seeds standing in for the usual peanuts.
swaps: Use GF tamari or coconut aminos for the soy sauce
watch: Check chile-garlic sauce and rotisserie chicken labels; contains coconut if using coconut aminos

title: Korean Beef Bowl
description: Sticky-sweet ground beef glazed with tamari, honey, garlic and ginger, spooned over rice with crunchy carrots and cucumbers.
watch: Confirm tamari is GF; if adding gochujang, many brands contain wheat/barley — check label or skip

title: Tuscan White Bean Soup
description: A lemony, herby pot of creamy cannellini beans, carrots, celery and kale in a tomato-tinged broth — cozy, hearty and naturally vegan.
watch: Check broth is GF

title: Chicken Tinga
description: Tender shredded chicken simmered in a smoky chipotle-tomato sauce, perfect piled into corn tortillas with avocado, cilantro and lime.
swaps: Skip the queso fresco/cotija and sour cream/crema toppings
watch: Check corn tortillas are certified GF; check chipotles in adobo label

title: Lemony Quinoa Kale Salad with Crispy Chickpeas
description: Massaged kale and fluffy quinoa with sun-dried tomatoes, sunflower seeds and oven-crisped chickpeas, all brightened by a maple-lemon-Dijon dressing.
swaps: Skip the goat cheese; skip the sourdough croutons (or make them with GF egg-free bread)

title: Jerk Tofu & Roasted Plantain Bowls
description: Spicy jerk-glazed tofu and caramelized sweet plantains with a zippy parsley-lime tahini sauce and a cool mango cucumber salad.
watch: Use GF tamari; if buying jerk seasoning or mango salsa instead of making them, check labels

title: Easy Salmon "Sushi" Bowls
description: Cubes of salmon marinated in tamari, sesame and ginger, roasted and served over seasoned sushi rice with avocado, scallions and crumbled nori.
watch: The linked cucumber salad is a separate recipe — use the plain sliced cucumber/carrot option or check it

title: Traditional Lentil Soup
description: Earthy brown lentils, carrots and celery in a smoky cumin-paprika broth, finished with fresh herbs and a squeeze of lemon.
watch: Check vegetable broth is GF

title: Easy Slow Cooker Vegan Chili
description: Three kinds of beans, sweet potato, corn and salsa go into the slow cooker with a touch of cocoa for a rich, dump-and-go chili.
watch: Check salsa and chili powder labels; toppings like vegan cheese/sour cream must be nut-free

title: Cold Italian Pasta Salad
description: Gluten-free rotini loaded with rainbow peppers, cucumber, tomatoes and olives, tossed in a punchy homemade herb-and-red-wine-vinegar dressing.
watch: Use certified GF pasta that is also egg-free

title: Salmon Rice Bowls
description: Sweet-and-spicy glazed salmon bites over rice with cucumber, carrot, edamame and avocado, drizzled with a creamy sriracha-lime sauce.
swaps: Make the sriracha mayo with egg-free vegan mayo
watch: Contains coconut (coconut aminos); check sriracha label

title: Healthy White Chicken Chili
description: Slow-cooked chicken thighs, white beans, poblanos and green chiles in a cumin-spiced broth that turns silky with a final stir of cream cheese and lime.
swaps: Use a nut-free dairy-free cream cheese (many are cashew/almond-based); skip cheese/sour cream toppings
watch: Check broth is GF; check dairy-free cream cheese is nut-free; contains coconut if using a coconut-based cream cheese

title: Healthy Chicken Lettuce Wraps
description: Savory chicken stir-fried with broccoli, water chestnuts and carrots in a ginger-rice-vinegar sauce, spooned into buttery lettuce cups with a tangy dipping sauce.
swaps: Use coconut aminos or GF tamari instead of soy sauce (in filling and dip); cook in oil, not butter/ghee
watch: Contains coconut if using coconut aminos; check sriracha label

title: Healthy Tuna Salad Without Mayo
description: Flaked tuna with finely minced carrot and celery in a creamy, garlicky dressing — a five-minute lunch for lettuce cups, GF crackers or toast.
swaps: Replace Greek yogurt with plain unsweetened nut-free dairy-free yogurt (soy or coconut) or egg-free vegan mayo
watch: Check dairy-free yogurt is nut-free; contains coconut if using coconut yogurt

title: Fresh Spring Rolls
description: Rice paper rolls stuffed with vermicelli, tofu, mango, avocado, crunchy veggies and fresh herbs — bright, colorful and fun to assemble.
swaps: Skip the peanut dipping sauce; serve with a tahini-ginger dressing (author's suggested alternative) or a tamari-lime-chili dip
watch: Check rice paper and noodles are wheat-free; use GF tamari

title: Red Lentil Soup
description: Velvety red lentils simmered with potato, carrot and cumin into a cozy golden soup, finished with lemon and a drizzle of olive oil.
watch: Check vegetable broth is GF

title: Vegan Pho
description: A fragrant star anise, cinnamon and charred-ginger broth deepened with shiitake and kombu, ladled over rice noodles, bok choy and tofu with heaps of fresh herbs.
watch: Check store-bought baked tofu, sriracha and chili oil labels

title: One Pot Moroccan-Inspired Chickpea Quinoa Salad
description: Turmeric- and cinnamon-spiced quinoa cooked in one pot with chickpeas, tart cranberries and fresh parsley — warm or cold, it packs beautifully.
swaps: Replace sliced almonds with toasted pepitas or sunflower seeds; use olive oil instead of coconut oil if preferred
watch: Check broth is GF (or use water); contains coconut if using coconut oil

title: Seriously, The Best Healthy Turkey Chili
description: Lean ground turkey, kidney beans, sweet corn and red pepper simmered in a well-spiced tomato base for a hearty, freezer-friendly chili.
swaps: Skip the cheese and sour cream toppings
watch: Check chicken broth and chili powder are GF; check tortilla chips if using

title: Herbed Spring Quinoa Salad
description: Quinoa and chickpeas tossed with snap peas, radishes, artichoke hearts and a fistful of cilantro, parsley and basil in a lemon-chili vinaigrette.

title: Rainbow Veggie Rolls
description: Homemade sushi rolls packed with roasted sweet potato, mango, avocado, cucumber and red pepper — sweet, creamy and crunchy in every bite.
swaps: Use GF tamari or coconut aminos instead of soy sauce for dipping
watch: Check rice vinegar is plain (not malt-based) and pickled ginger label

title: Egg Roll in a Bowl
description: All the flavor of an egg roll without the wrapper: ground pork and shredded cabbage stir-fried in a savory coconut aminos-ginger sauce with a hit of fish sauce.
watch: Contains coconut (coconut aminos); check broth and fish sauce are GF

title: Easy, Gluten-Free Tacos
description: Seasoned ground beef (or turkey) tucked into crisp, pan-fried corn tortillas and topped with lettuce, tomato and salsa — a classic taco night, no wheat required.
swaps: Skip cheese and sour cream (or use nut-free dairy-free versions)
watch: Check corn tortillas are certified GF; check the homemade taco seasoning link and salsa labels

title: Gluten-Free Fish Tacos
description: Crispy spiced tilapia bites tucked into corn tortillas with crunchy slaw, cilantro and plenty of lime.
swaps: Use a nut-free dairy-free milk (e.g. rice or soy) in the dredge — not milk or almond milk; use the cornmeal option for the coating instead of breadcrumbs; make the slaw with egg-free vegan mayo or a simple lime-oil dressing
watch: Check GF flour blend is egg-free; check corn tortillas are certified GF

title: Gluten Free Dairy Free Potato Soup (One-Pot!)
description: A thick, creamy one-pot potato soup enriched with coconut milk and thyme, topped with crispy bacon and green onions.
watch: Contains coconut (coconut milk); check broth and bacon are GF; any dairy-free cheese/sour cream topping must be nut-free

title: Lemongrass Chicken Noodle Bowls
description: Vietnamese-style bowls of lemongrass-garlic chicken over rice vermicelli with crisp lettuce, herbs, cucumber and carrots, drenched in a sweet-sour nuoc cham.
swaps: Omit the crushed peanuts (try toasted sesame or sunflower seeds); use GF tamari or coconut aminos for the soy sauce
watch: Check fish sauce is GF; check vermicelli is 100% rice
